info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Meetings Meetings Participants-v4-spec
info.description: The Meetings Participants Retrieval API enables users to access detailed information about participants of specific meetings. This endpoint allows businesses and developers to efficiently query participant lists based on meeting identifiers, providing insights into attendance and engagement. Typical consumers include event organizers, scheduling applications, and team collaboration tools that require participant visibility for meetings. This API streamlines participant management and enhances the overall meeting experience.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of participants in a meeting.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all participants associated with a specific meeting. It provides details about each participant, including their status and roles in the meeting.
